title: Displacement Exponents for Low-Dimensional Self-Avoiding Walks
exact_target:
For self-avoiding walk in dimensions $d=2$ and $d=3$, prove that there exists $\varepsilon>0$ such that

$$n^{2/d+\varepsilon}\leq \mathbb E_n[\operatorname{Dist}(\gamma_n,0)^2]\leq n^{2-\varepsilon}$$

for all sufficiently large $n$.
